_note: cap_citation is null where there is no statewide cap; notice_over_threshold is null where a single flat notice period applies. CPI-indexed caps change annually; re-verify.
_notice: General reference, not legal advice. Statutes change and vary by jurisdiction; verify every figure against the current official state code before relying on it. Last reviewed 2026-05.

CA.cap_summary: 5% + regional CPI, capped at 10% total, per 12-month period (AB 1482-covered housing, generally 15+ years old)
CA.notice_under_threshold: 30 days when the increase is 10% or less
CA.notice_over_threshold: 90 days when the cumulative 12-month increase exceeds 10%

FL.cap_summary: No statewide cap. Local governments are barred from imposing rent controls.
FL.notice_under_threshold: No mid-term increase. For a month-to-month tenancy the terms change with 30 days' notice (60 days year-to-year).

IL.cap_summary: No statewide cap. The Rent Control Preemption Act bars all local rent control, including home-rule cities.
IL.notice_under_threshold: No rent-increase-specific statute; a month-to-month increase rides the 30-day termination notice (7 days week-to-week).

MA.cap_summary: No statewide cap. Rent control has been banned statewide since 1994.
MA.notice_under_threshold: For a tenancy at will, the landlord must end the old tenancy and offer a new one with notice of at least 30 days or one full rental period, whichever is longer.

NJ.cap_summary: No statewide cap, but over 100 municipalities have local rent control, and any increase must not be 'unconscionable' under the Anti-Eviction Act.
NJ.notice_under_threshold: No mid-lease increase. The landlord must end the old tenancy with a Notice to Quit plus notice of the increase, at least one full rental period (30 days for month-to-month).

NY.cap_summary: No statewide cap. Rent stabilization limits increases only in covered units (mostly New York City and localities that opt in).
NY.notice_under_threshold: For an increase over 5% or a non-renewal: 30 days' notice if the tenant has occupied under 1 year, 60 days for 1-2 years, 90 days for 2+ years

OR.cap_summary: Statewide cap: the lesser of 10% or 7% + CPI per 12 months (9.5% for 2026; 10.0% in 2025). Does not apply in the first year of tenancy or to housing under 15 years old.
OR.notice_under_threshold: 90 days' written notice for a rent increase on a month-to-month tenancy

TX.cap_summary: No statewide cap. Local rent control is barred unless a disaster-based ordinance is approved by the governor.
TX.notice_under_threshold: No statutory advance-notice period; rent may be raised only at lease renewal, not during the term.

WA.cap_summary: Statewide cap (effective 2025): 7% + CPI or 10% per 12 months, whichever is less, recalculated annually by the Department of Commerce. Newer buildings and certain tenancies are exempt.
WA.notice_under_threshold: 90 days' written notice for a rent increase (30 days for subsidized tenancies)
